claim_short: Complete balanced 10x6x5x4x10 factorial, no missing data
check_performed: recounted every (model, language, pairing, scale) group
check_result: all groups of size 10, 1 distinct size; balanced = True
note: deterministic recount, nothing here can break

claim_short: Rounds are 20-fold pseudoreplicated; cluster on games
check_performed: rounds per game, plus the design effect of ignoring the game cluster
check_result: 20 rounds per game; the naive round-level CI is 0.4x too narrow (design effect 8)
note: quantified directly in R02; the anticonservatism is large

claim_short: Raw payoff scales with lambda at exponent 1 by construction
check_performed: refit log10 mean raw payoff on log10 lambda
note: an algebraic identity, not an empirical scaling law

claim_short: The logged payoffs reproduce the dilemma gradient
check_performed: Spearman of own and opponent cooperation on own utility
note: the sign pattern is forced by the payoff matrix; a units check

check_performed: constant-sequence share pooled and boundary mass within every model
check_result: pooled constant-sequence share 0.395; per-model boundary mass spans 0.086 to 0.604
note: the per-model spread is the robust part; the pooled U shape aggregates very different per-model shapes and should not be quoted on its own

claim_short: Frontier LLMs are not invariant to positive payoff rescaling
check_performed: exact within-cell permutation (5,000 draws), all 29 leave-one-out subsets, trimming to 20% of cells
check_result: p_perm = 2.0e-04 on the spread of the level means; 29 of 29 leave-one-out subsets still reject; 6 of 6 models and 5 of 5 languages reject alone
note: survived every attack made in this section

claim_short: Cooperation RISES with lambda, about +0.013 per decade
check_result: pooled +0.0134; the sign flips in 4 of 29 subsets: dropping Grok (-0.0026), dropping the CvC pairing (-0.0018), dropping lambda = 0.01 and 0.1 (-0.0077) and dropping 0.01, 0.1 and 0.25; 3 of 6 models have a negative slope
note: a pooled average over opposite-sign subgroups; it must not be reported as a shared tendency of frontier LLMs

claim_short: The violation is concentrated at sub-unit lambda
check_performed: drop lambda = 0.01 and 0.1 and re-run the permutation test
check_result: the spread falls from 0.125 to 0.056 but still rejects (p = 5.0e-04); the saturated form beats the linear one by 146 AIC
note: the small-lambda rungs carry most of the effect but not all of it; only two rungs sit below lambda = 0.25, so the knee is weakly located

claim_short: Lambda acts by re-weighting unconditional policies
check_performed: Spearman of the always-C and never-C shares on log lambda over the 10 rungs
note: only the never-cooperate half is supported; the always-cooperate correlation cannot be distinguished from zero on 10 points, so the symmetric 'two atoms move in opposition' phrasing overstates it
